idea: Pythagorean-tiling candidate: tile the plane with two square sizes a and b in the Pythagorean (pinwheel) arrangement, optionally rotated by a small angle. Optimise a, b, the offset and the angle numerically to see whether the two-size lattice beats grid families for some n.
